description: Deploy the application with its own deploy script, gated by build and test validation, verified by a health check, tagged, and audited. aidd orchestrates; the project owns the deploy command and credentials.
name: deploy

parameters.description: Command that performs the deployment (runs in the project directory)
parameters.name: deployCommand

parameters.description: URL to poll after deploying (e.g. https://example.com/api/v1/health); empty skips the check
parameters.name: healthUrl

configJson.command: if [ -n "{healthUrl}" ]; then curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 5 --retry-delay 3 --retry-all-errors "{healthUrl}" > /dev/null && echo "healthy: {healthUrl}"; else echo "No healthUrl provided; skipping health check"; fi
